title: God of War III Remastered (PC port)
description: God of War III Remastered (PS4) for Windows and Linux (experimental AppImage). Original x86-64 code runs directly on the CPU with a custom runtime; graphics use shadPS4's Vulkan video core and cuesta4's fixes. Launcher, in-game menu, controller icons and up to 240 FPS.
